explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and fires only at GO when the agent picks a1 right after a rewarded trial that had a common transition (a1 to S1): usually 7-10 in trials about 5-60, 3-5 around trials 60-75, and near 0 after about trial 75, with runs of rewarded a1 trials staying high. GO is 0-1 if the previous trial was unrewarded, if its reward came after a rare transition, or (almost always) if the agent picks a2.
